rules: https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf: Canceling Game Text p23, starting setup pp35-36, Dark Forces p141 and For Luck p143

limitations: Starting branch comparison verifies offered choices when GEMP requires a chooser, and actual final piles in every branch, not exact random shuffle order.
